reasons.plausibility: Mentioning Laves phases with elements not in the stated powder feedstock creates confusion, but overall the proposed hardening and toughening mechanisms via HEBM and SPS are broadly consistent with known phenomena for high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: A clear set of hardness and XRD measurements provides a concrete experimental route to verify phase formation and strength changes compared to the cast baseline.
reasons.usefulness: Although it suggests an approach to enhance properties, it does not directly clarify the role of existing phases in the original low hardness and strength, limiting its practical utility in explaining the initial problem.
